notes: Clients — bulk import from Excel is now available: download a ready-to-fill import template (correct columns, one worked example row), fill in as many clients as needed, and import in one go. Existing clients are matched by GSTIN, so re-importing the same sheet safely updates them instead of creating duplicates, and any row with a problem (missing name, invalid GSTIN/PAN, etc.) is reported individually without blocking the rest of the sheet.
